# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Engine and WebAssembly updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adopts Skia m159 and raises the WebAssembly minimum to .NET 9. The engine update brings WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image and rendering fixes. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support remains unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move .NET 8 WebAssembly apps to a supported toolchain** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets; unsupported WASM target frameworks now fail before building. Retarget WASM apps to .NET 9 or later and use runtime-matched archives: .NET 9/10 use Emscripten 3.1.56, while .NET 11+ uses 6.0.2. These archives are not interchangeable with older .NET toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))

## Engine

- **Skia m159** — Updates the native renderer with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image and rendering correctness fixes. Public managed signatures remain unchanged. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **OS-generated hash seeds** — The shared HashCode polyfill now seeds from the operating system random-number generator. Hash codes remain randomized per process and stable within a process; first use now loads System.Security.Cryptography, adding initialization cost. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
